content: Formspree and Web3Forms are the two dominant no-backend form services. Formspree: polished dashboard, reCAPTCHA/honeypot spam protection, paid tiers start ~0/mo, smaller free tier. Web3Forms: free tier of 250 submissions/month, hCaptcha spam protection, simpler email-only focus, no dashboard on free tier. For a low-traffic personal portfolio contact form, Web3Forms' free tier is sufficient and requires only a POST fetch from a plain HTML form -- no new dependency.
